---
title: "CA - BF[1] Factor Structure"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
library(mosaic)
library(tidyverse)
library(readr)
library(emmeans)
library(car)
```


```{r}
set.seed(4782055)
Store <- paste("store", seq(1:96))
AvgFootTraffic <- c(floor(rnorm(48, mean=120, sd=7)), floor(rnorm(48, mean=160, sd=9)))
WindowTreatment <- rep(c("Current", "New"), each = 48, times =1)
```

```{r}
WindowDataBF1 <- tibble(Store, AvgFootTraffic, WindowTreatment)
```

```{r}
windowaov <- aov(AvgFootTraffic ~ WindowTreatment, data = WindowDataBF1)
summary(windowaov)
dummy.coef(windowaov)
```


```{r}
favstats(WindowDataBF1$AvgFootTraffic)
favstats(WindowDataBF1$AvgFootTraffic ~ WindowDataBF1$WindowTreatment)
favstats(AvgFootTraffic ~ WindowTreatment, data = WindowDataBF1)
boxplot(AvgFootTraffic ~ WindowTreatment, data = WindowDataBF1)
```


```{r}
bonedata <- read.csv("../data/Bonemineral.csv")
headdata <- read.csv("../data/headinjury.csv")
```


```{r}
View(bonedata)
favstats(bonedata$BMD)
favstats(bonedata$BMD ~ bonedata$Treatment)
boxplot(BMD ~ Treatment, data = bonedata)
```

```{r}
myaov <- aov(BMD ~ Treatment, data = bonedata, contrasts = list(Treatment = contr.sum))
summary(myaov)
dummy.coef(myaov)
```
```{r}
par(mfrow = c(1,3))
plot(myaov, which = 1)
plot(myaov, which = 2)
qqPlot(myaov$residuals)
```


```{r}
View(headdata)
favstats(headdata$HeadInjury)
favstats(headdata$HeadInjury ~ headdata$Type)
boxplot(HeadInjury ~ Type, data = headdata)
```
```{r}
myaov <- aov(HeadInjury ~ Type, data = headdata)
summary(myaov)
```
```{r}
head_means <- emmeans(myaov, "Type")
head_means
contrast(head_means, list(i = c(-1/4,-1/4,-1/4,-1/4,1/3,1/3,1/3),
                          ii = c(-1/2,1/2,-1/2,1/2,0,0,0),
                          iii = c(-1,0,1,0,0,0,0)),adjust = "none")
```


```{r}
IVData <- read_csv("../data/data_for_class/Data/IVData.csv")
View(IVData)
```
```{r}
myaov <- aov(Particles ~ Companies, data = IVData)
summary(myaov)
```

```{r}
IV_means <- emmeans(myaov, "Companies")
IV_means
```
```{r}
contrast(IV_means, list(Abbot_vs_McGaw = c(1,0,-1)),adjust = "")
```


```{r}
favstats(IVData$Particles ~ IVData$Companies)
```
```{r}
stripchart(Particles ~ Companies, data = IVData, vertical = TRUE)
```
```{r}
par(mfrow = c(1,3))
plot(myaov, which = 1)
plot(myaov, which = 2)
qqPlot(myaov$residuals)
```
```{r}
leveneTest(myaov)
```
